title: Smoke-load an HTTP GET
summary: A few virtual users hit GET /items/1; fail if errors or p95 climb.
description: The smallest useful load test: start samples/js-api, apply a short smoke of concurrent GETs, and fail the run if the error rate or p95 latency crosses a threshold. Compare k6 and Artillery on the same contract.
architecture: This is not a unit or integration assertion on one response. A load generator opens several virtual users against a real port, records latency and status codes, then evaluates thresholds. Duration stays short (~8s) so CI stays cheap — the idea is “does the handler survive a puff of traffic?”, not a soak.

variants.label: k6
variants.notes: Needs the k6 binary on PATH (brew install k6; CI uses grafana/setup-k6-action).
